maria: Quick sync — hetero-quant bakeoff results + rollout proposal. AWQ-int8 (A), GPTQ-int8 (B), fp8-mix (C). Summary numbers from eval suite:
- golden accuracy delta vs float32: A: -0.9%, B: -1.4%, C: -0.5%
- p95 latency on a100-40g: A=110ms, B=130ms, C=125ms
- memory: A < B < C (A wins)
Proposed rollout: hosted -> dedicated -> private. Canary steps: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with metric gates and auto-fallback. Looking for objections.

samir: what was the eval set size and sampling distribution?

maria: eval set = 10k queries (production-weighted): doc-summarization 40%, chat 30%, code 15%, search 15%. We included a 1k adversarial golden subset and 200 targeted code-completion edgecases.

eli: rollback thresholds?

maria: gating rules (proposal): absolute golden delta > 1.5% OR critical-subset regression > 1.0% OR p99 latency increase > 25% OR error-rate > 0.5% triggers immediate rollback. Automatic fallback first tries the float32 variant, then an alternate quant variant if configured.

tess: for hosted routing we should add policy to prefer cheaper variant when quality delta <= 0.5% (to keep cost wins).

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: canary-quant-2026-03-20. traffic_steps=[1,5,20,100]. alert_targets=[#eng-ml,#incidents]. auto-revert=true.

qa-bot: smoke tests: AWQ-int8 hosted sanity (200 samples) -> PASS, but 3/200 failures on code-completion due to tokenization mismatch. Uploading failure cases to artifacts.

samir: for private/on-prem customers, do we allow CPU fallback or force GPU-only?

maria: private defaults: cpu_fallback=false for latency-sensitive tenants. For others we enable cached-KV fallback when OOM. We'll expose per-tenant policy: {"cpu_fallback":bool, "kv_cache_fallback":bool}.

eli: please ensure quant metadata recorded in model registry: method (AWQ/GPTQ/FP8), bits, per-channel flag, kernel tags (aten-fused, fused-attn), quant-seed, perf-profile-id. Needed for reproducing bakeoffs.

maria: action items:
1) @samir run extended eval 100k overnight and push diffs
2) @tess finalize routing policy JSON and thresholds
3) @eli add metadata capture + CI gate (fail build on missing metadata)
4) @nate run private smoke with customer-X tomorrow morning
I'll open rollout ticket with links to artifacts and dashboards. :thumbsup:

nate: ack. I'll capture token-level diffs and perf counters under /artifacts/quant-bakeoff-2501234567.

maria: sample rollback rule (added to rollout playbook):
```
if delta_golden > 0.015 or p99_latency_ratio > 1.25:
  revert("variant", to="float32")
  notify(#incidents, subject="quant variant rollback: reason=gate")
```

maria: quick note — AWQ-int8 likely our best cost/latency balance for hosted. FP8 mix is appealing for private (memory-constrained) but needs more stability on code paths. Let's reconvene after samir's 100k run. :eyes:
